source.title: Shirudo: OpenAI and Cisco's open-source runtime for shielding unpatched Linux
source.author: acossta

excerpt.zh: Shirudo是OpenAI与Cisco开源的Linux运行时防护工具，可在服务不停机、补丁尚未部署时拦截特定漏洞利用；其效果仍需在真实环境中验证。
excerpt.en: Shirudo is an open-source Linux runtime defense from OpenAI and Cisco. It can block a targeted exploit while a service stays online, but protections still need validation in real environments.

disclosure.en: This article was automatically generated by the Weekly Day AI gateway model using content from Hacker News.

text.zh: Shirudo是OpenAI与Cisco推出的开源Linux运行时防护工具，目标是在团队准备和部署补丁期间保护仍在运行的服务。它通过针对漏洞行为设置临时防护措施，尝试避免为了封堵攻击而直接中断业务。
text.en: Shirudo is an open-source Linux runtime defense introduced by OpenAI and Cisco. It aims to protect services while teams prepare and deploy patches, using temporary, targeted safeguards to avoid taking applications offline just to block an attack.

text.zh: Shirudo如何为运行中的Linux服务加防护
text.en: How Shirudo shields running Linux services

text.zh: Shirudo使用eBPF在操作系统的特定位置观察活动并实施防护。团队可以先检查防护措施对应用的影响，再由运维人员批准部署。项目还描述了签名验证、Linux内核的eBPF安全检查，以及借助TPM记录防护加载或移除情况等机制。
text.en: Shirudo uses eBPF to observe activity and apply protections at selected points in the operating system. Teams can assess a proposed shield's effects on an application before an operator approves deployment. The project also describes signed shields, Linux eBPF safety checks, and TPM-backed records of protections being loaded or removed.

text.zh: OpenAI称，在一次受控测试中，团队借助Codex为Java的Base64解码器生成输入检查，并将其附加到运行中的Elasticsearch进程，成功阻止Java4Shell利用尝试，且无需重启服务。这是单个测试案例，不足以证明防护在不同工作负载或生产环境中都能可靠运行。
text.en: OpenAI says that in a controlled test, its team used Codex to generate an input check for Java's Base64 decoder and attach it to a running Elasticsearch process. The shield blocked a Java4Shell exploit attempt without a restart. This is one test case, not evidence that the approach will work reliably across different workloads or production environments.

text.zh: Shirudo的验证与部署仍是关键问题
text.en: Validation and deployment remain key questions for Shirudo

text.zh: 这类临时防护针对一个现实难题：恶意利用和正常请求有时会依赖相同的系统操作，简单封锁可能导致服务失效。Shirudo希望让防守方在修补漏洞前更精确地限制风险，但防护是否会误拦合法流量、如何在复杂环境中充分测试，以及大规模部署和恢复能否安全进行，仍有待实践检验。项目以BSD 2-Clause等许可开源，邀请开发者、安全研究人员和基础设施运维者参与。
text.en: Temporary shields address a practical challenge: malicious exploits and legitimate requests can sometimes depend on the same system operation, so blocking it outright may disrupt a service. Shirudo aims to limit exposure more precisely while a permanent fix is prepared. Whether shields avoid blocking legitimate traffic, how thoroughly they can be tested in complex environments, and whether deployment and recovery remain safe at scale are still open questions. The project is open source under licenses including BSD 2-Clause, and invites developers, security researchers, and infrastructure operators to contribute.
